## Purpose

Describe the listing/content change and affected application ids.

## Evidence

Link official sources and identify the checked upstream/client revisions.
For assistant content, attach the completed
[assistant review record](../templates/assistant-review.md).

## Scope and compatibility

- [ ] Existing registry format and client permission boundaries are preserved.
- [ ] New application listings include the required assistant package.
- [ ] English/Chinese content agrees; no secrets or personal configuration are included.
- [ ] Supported versus planned client behavior is stated accurately.

## Validation

List checks actually performed, observations and untested scenarios.
For documentation/template-only changes, mark runtime checks not applicable.

## Rollback and dependencies

Describe Git rollback and any required client work. Link related PRs; declare
`Depends on #...` when this change requires another unmerged change.
